description.en: Extends VBench to image-to-video generation and adds trustworthiness dimensions, so its totals are computed over a different dimension set. A VBench++ number is not a VBench number for the same model.

released_reference.note: First version of the paper introducing VBench++. It extends VBench to image-to-video generation over a different dimension set, so this dates a distinct instrument rather than the 2023 VBench release.
